verses.gurmukhi: ੬ : ਗੁਰ ਦੀ ਗਣਤ ਗਣਨ ਵਾਲਾ ਦੁਖੀ
verses.translit_en: 6 : gur dhee ganat ganan vaalaa dhukhee

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਭਨਾ ਦੇ ਸਿਰ ਗੁੰਦੀਅਨਿ ਗੰਜੀ ਗੁਰੜਾਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: sabhanaa dhe sir gu(n)dheean ga(n)jee guraRaavai|

en.bdb: The hairs of all are dressed but the bald lady mumbles.
The beautiful woman wears the earnings but the earless one grumbles.

verses.gurmukhi: ਨਥਾਂ ਨਕਿ ਨਵੇਲੀਆਂ ਨਕਟੀ ਨ ਸੁਖਾਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: nathaa(n) nak naveleeaa(n) nakaTee na sukhaavai|

en.bdb: The newly wed girls wear nose rings but the noseless feels uncomfortable (for not being able to wear nose ring).
The deer-eyed ladies put in the collyrium but the one-eyed wails and cries.
All have a pleasing gait but the lame limps.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗਣਤ ਗਣੈ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਦੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਦੁਖਿ ਵਿਹਾਵੈ ॥੬॥
verses.translit_en: ganat ganai gurdhev dhee tis dhukh vihaavai ||6||

en.bdb: Those who slander the Guru, spend their life in sorrows.
